# Cncf Securecodebox Reviewer

Review secureCodeBox using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. secureCodeBox is an OWASP project providing an automated and scalable open source solution that integrates multiple security scanners with a simple and lightweight interface – for continuous and automated security testing.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
